name: FitLife Gym Management
summary: A school project exploring a Flutter mobile client connected to a shared PHP REST API backend.
details: The project is planned as a shared system: a web interface and Android app use the same backend API. Current work is focused on a realistic MVP and learning the integration step by step.

name: SQI Checkmate Arena
summary: A chess-club application concept for organizing a campus chess community and its activities.
details: The project is being approached UI-first, with backend integration planned after the core experience and screens are established.

name: Oyo Empire Strategy Game
summary: A strategy-game prototype inspired by the history and political structure of the Oyo Empire.
details: The prototype explores a turn-and-time-driven management experience, with an emphasis on representing institutions, decisions and historical context thoughtfully.
